label: Path-scope strictness and coverage-versus-path separation certificate
meaning: Reuses the prior offWorldContingent and rootedPair certificates; verifies the new path properties or their failure without duplicating those model proofs. An absent-actual contingent source defeats all-source path transport while necessary-source transport survives; a reversed cross-world pair defeats necessary-source transport despite coverage and actual WF. All interpretations and scopes are explicit, not objections to premise warrant.
